title: 72 terror launchpads become operational in Pakistan since Operation Sindoor: BSF
description: At least 72 terror launchpads have become operational across the border in Pakistan, including 12 near Sialkot and Zaffarwal, since Operation Sindoor, the Border Security Force (BSF) said on Saturday, adding the force was fully alert to maintain “zero” cross-border infiltration of terrorists in the Jammu region. | India News

title: Lt Gen Manjinder Singh says Pakistan 'yielded in 19 hours' during 'Operation Sindoor'
description: CHANDIGARH, Nov 29: During Operation Sindoor, the Indian armed forces were prepared for a prolonged confrontation, and the Army had even readied a reserve list of ex-servicemen to be mobilised if needed. However, the situation de-escalated far sooner than expected, with Pakistan “kneeling in just 19 hours”, South Western Command’s Lieutenant General Manjinder Singh said on Saturday. title: Cross-Border Conflict: Nilgai's Tragic Fate in Pakistan
description: A nilgai that wandered into Pakistan from India was killed by locals after damaging their crops. The incident occurred in Bahawalnagar, near Lahore. Police have filed a case against 12 people for allegedly hunting and torturing the animal. No arrests have been made so far.

title: Faf du Plessis pulls out of 2026 auction after 14 seasons, switches from IPL to PSL
description: Former South Africa captain Faf du Plessis will not participate in the 2026 IPL auction after a 14-season stint, opting for a new challenge in the Pakistan Super League. Du Plessis, who won two IPL titles with Chennai Super Kings, expressed gratitude for his time in India and looks forward to experiencing Pakistani hospitality and a new league.

title: 'Operation Sindoor reflected our operational capability; Pakistan had panicked': Top Army official | EXCLUSIVE
description: In an exclusive interview with India TV, Lieutenant General Manjinder Singh, General Officer Commanding-in-Chief (GOC-in-C) of the South Western Command (Sapta Shakti Command), said the armed forces were able to completely destroy nine terror camps and avenge the April 22 Pahalgam terror attack.

title: BIG NEWS: Faf du Plessis chooses Pakistan's PSL over India's IPL
description: Veteran South African cricketer has chosen to play in PSL 2026 and opted out of IPL 2026

title: ‘A new challenge’: Faf du Plessis skips IPL, set to play PSL
description: Faf du Plessis, former South Africa skipper, will not participate in the upcoming IPL auction after 14 seasons in the league. He will instead play in the Pakistan Super League, expressing gratitude towards the IPL and India while looking forward to new challenges and hospitality in Pakistan.

title: How A Cancelled Oxford Union Debate Turned Into A Full-Blown India-Pakistan Social Media War
description: An Oxford Union debate on India-Pakistan policy was cancelled minutes before it began as Pakistan’s delegation failed to arrive on time. The incident ignited a social media uproar.
